audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer repeatedly labels Galio's taunt as coming off Winds of War (Q) — 'bait his E-Q taunt combo', 'A Justice Punch (E) into Winds of War (Q) taunt chain', 'his E-into-Q taunt and R'.
audit.why: Galio's kit has the taunt on Shield of Durand (W), not Winds of War (Q), which is a windblast DoT with no taunt or hard CC. The real combo is Justice Punch (E, dash-knockup) into Shield of Durand (W, taunt).
audit.corrected: Replaced every Q taunt reference with W (Shield of Durand).
